# The wire-bond baseline

Wire bonding is the packaging any solder-ball route is compared against. Wire
bonding to a small interposer or chip-on-board is what wafer.space sells at
\$1.50 per die[^wafer-space], and a CERN-hosted seminar deck recommends a
wire-bond interposer for prototyping bumped chips[^kreidl]. Any solder-ball
route has to beat wire bonding on size or on signal integrity to be worth the
effort. Results from earlier runs are in [Past wafer.space runs](../past-runs.md).
